Package com.csse3200.game.maps

Class MapGraph

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.maps.MapGraph
All Implemented Interfaces:
EncounterCallback
public class MapGraph extends Object implements EncounterCallback
Represents the map graph containing all map nodes.

      public void connectNodes(Integer firstId, Integer secondId)
      Connects two nodes by id. Kept so callers outside this package can connect nodes without looking them up first, which the encounter integration relies on.

      secondId - id of the second node
